chat: Discussion: [Bob]: I was in Medbay doing tasks and didn't see Nina enter or leave, so I think we should skip this round to let Ian and Modi explain their erratic movements since neither has given a solid alibi yet.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: I can confirm Macroon is correct; I saw Bob in the Cafeteria during Round 1, so Bob, why did you claim to be in Medbay?

chat: Discussion: [Ian]: Bob, you're trying to shift the focus onto my movements to cover up the fact that both Macroon and Dave caught you lying about being in Medbay when you were actually in the Cafeteria.

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: Bob, you specifically said you were in Medbay during the time Macroon and Dave saw you in the Cafeteria, so Doraemon's point about you being in Medbay later doesn't explain why you lied about your initial location.

chat: Discussion: [Modi]: I can confirm I was with Charlie, Macroon, and Ian in Admin during Round 4 and 5, and Ian and I were together in Storage during Round 6, so we aren't coordinating anything suspicious—unlike Bob, who still hasn't explained why he lied about being in Medbay when Macroon, Dave, and Liam all saw him in the Cafeteria.

chat: Discussion: [Mona]: I can also confirm that Bob was in the Cafeteria during Round 1 emptying the trash, so Doraemon's observation of him in Medbay later doesn't excuse the fact that he lied about his location.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Bob's claim that he "mixed up his rounds" is a weak excuse, especially since he's now aggressively pushing for a vote on Ian to deflect from the fact that multiple people caught him lying.

chat: Discussion: [Liam]: It is logically inconsistent for Bob to dismiss his own location error as a "mix-up" while simultaneously demanding a precise, detailed accounting of Ian's movements, which is a classic over-correction to deflect suspicion.
